text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, silly! The Arima Kinen!!
What a truly, truuuly dreamy race it is!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-san, Ticket-san,
Rice-san, Palmer-san. And then—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Aren't all the stars of the current
Twinkle Series gathered right here?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on this!
For self-producing, I need to see how everyone else makes their mark!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
we're going to watch the Arima Kinen in person!
choice_data_list: Nice Nature and Tannhauser are running too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We have to cheer on those two as well,
so they don't feel intimidated among all these stars!!

At the end of December, we'll watch the Arima Kinen.
Let's make sure not to schedule any races.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: You're finally making your comeback... Teio-san!
